text_block_list.text:
Having lost all confidence,
El Condor Pasa 
casts aside the mask that is her very 
symbol and disappears without a trace.

The Trainer managed to find El Condor 
Pasa,
but she was feeling deeply dejected, 
convinced she was a liar for hiding her 
true face and putting up a front to run.

The Trainer tells El Condor Pasa that
even 
behind a mask, everything she has 
accomplished is real, and hands her the 
mask.

Furthermore, after receiving a pep talk 
from Grass Wonder, she found the courage 
to put her mask back on herself. ...And 
thus, the "Phantom Bird" was reborn!

Setting her sights on the Japan Cup once 
more, she aimed for the Takarazuka Kinen 
as a stepping stone toward her goal.
